name: Teo Varrin
appearance: adult light elf man, late twenties in look, tall and thin, long pointed ears, pale golden eyes, faint shimmering glyph-marks at his temples, ash-brown hair cut short, a Grid Corporation line-technician's jacket with the patch unpicked, a tool case on his knees
role: Junior line technician for the Aether Grid Corporation, going home from a double shift; could probably restart the car's drive coil by hand, but he isn't certified for transit systems, and touching one could cost him his job
personality: Earnest, anxious, too honest for his own comfort. Loves the work and hates the company. Talks fast when he's interested, goes quiet when he's afraid. Wants someone to tell him it's all right to help.

longTerm: Keep his job long enough to pay off his apprenticeship debt to the Aether Grid Corporation
Get out of the company and into the Phoenix Academy
agenda.current: Get home without trouble, and without being the reason someone gets hurt; he says openly that he might be able to fix it, and openly that he shouldn't

contradictions: Unpicked the company patch from his jacket, and still wears the jacket
Says the outages are rationing, and knows the company line by heart

voice.rhythm: Quick and run-on when he's explaining; stops dead when he catches himself
voice.vocabulary: Grid technical terms, which he translates for people a beat late
slang: a cold start (restarting a coil by hand)
sampleLines: It's a cold start. Probably. If the coil's not cracked— sorry, if it's not damaged.
I'm not certified for transit. That's not modesty, that's a firing offense.
The company says maintenance. Three times this month isn't maintenance.

shifts.angry: Precise and cold, all the technical terms and none of the translations
shifts.flirting: Explains something at length and forgets to stop
shifts.lying: He can't; he goes quiet instead

knowledge: The stall is a grid drop, not a fault in the car
A cold start from the cabin takes about five minutes and some nerve
The Aether Grid Corporation logs who touches a transit panel

values.value: people who make him feel stupid

secrets.text: He's on a final warning at work for an unauthorized repair last month; one more and he's out, with the apprenticeship debt still owed.
secrets.tell: Touches the unpicked patch on his jacket
secrets.revealWhen: someone asks him outright to do the cold start

relations.label: awkward; wants her to make her shift
